verdict.rationale: Zapier's platform is built on triggers: integrations define triggers and actions (zapier-docs-1), implemented as webhooks or polling triggers (zapier-docs-3). Users describe event-driven 'if this then that' Zaps across connected apps, including webhook and calendar-sync workflows (zapier-comm-1, zapier-comm-3, zapier-comm-4, zapier-comm-8). Most of this evidence is developer-side or implied rather than end-user documentation. Missing for 10: ops-user docs on configuring app-event triggers, explicit evidence for the specific event types named in the story (new record, message, email, form submission), and hands-on corroboration of trigger reliability.
